title: 第34课 · 听说她唱得不错
subtitle: Lesson 34 — 听说她唱得不错 · I heard she sings well

items.py: Tīng shuō tā chàng de búcuò.
items.en: I heard she sings well.

items.py: Tīng shuō tā yào jiéhūn le.
items.en: I heard he's getting married.

items.py: Jù shuō nàge dìfang hěn měi.
items.en: It's said that place is very beautiful.

items.zh: 大家都说这个老师教得好。
items.py: Dàjiā dōu shuō zhège lǎoshī jiāo de hǎo.
items.en: Everyone says this teacher teaches well.

items.zh: 我听朋友说那个电影很好看。
items.py: Wǒ tīng péngyou shuō nàge diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn.
items.en: My friend told me that movie is very good.

items.py: Wǎnhuì shénme shíhou kāishǐ?
items.en: When does the party start?

items.zh: 刘京：周末有联欢会，你去吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhōumò yǒu liánhuānhuì, nǐ qù ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: There's a party this weekend, are you going?

items.py: Dàwèi: Shénme liánhuānhuì?
items.en: David: What party?

items.zh: 刘京：留学生联欢会。听说玛丽要唱歌。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Liúxuéshēng liánhuānhuì. Tīng shuō Mǎlì yào chàng gē.
items.en: Liu Jing: Exchange student party. I heard Mary is going to sing.

items.py: Dàwèi: Tīng shuō tā chàng de búcuò.
items.en: David: I heard she sings well.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Hézǐ yě yào tiào wǔ ne.
items.en: Liu Jing: Hezi is going to dance too.

items.zh: 大卫：那一定很精彩。我一定去。
items.py: Dàwèi: Nà yīdìng hěn jīngcǎi. Wǒ yīdìng qù.
items.en: David: It must be wonderful. I'll definitely go.

items.zh: 玛丽：听说张老师要去美国了？
items.py: Mǎlì: Tīng shuō Zhāng lǎoshī yào qù Měiguó le?
items.en: Mary: I heard Teacher Zhang is going to America?

items.zh: 和子：是的，听说她去做访问学者。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, tīng shuō tā qù zuò fǎngwèn xuézhě.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, I heard she's going as a visiting scholar.

items.py: Mǎlì: Qù duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: Mary: How long?

items.py: Hézǐ: Jù shuō yào qù yī nián.
items.en: Hezi: It's said she'll go for a year.

items.zh: 玛丽：那我们应该去送送她。
items.py: Mǎlì: Nà wǒmen yīnggāi qù sòngsong tā.
items.en: Mary: Then we should go see her off.

items.zh: 和子：好主意！我们送她一个礼物吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Hǎo zhǔyi! Wǒmen sòng tā yī ge lǐwù ba.
items.en: Hezi: Good idea! Let's give her a gift.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (听说 / 据说 Hearsay)

items.py: Tīng shuō tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
items.en: I heard he speaks Chinese well.

items.zh: 据说那个饭馆儿很好吃。
items.py: Jù shuō nàge fànguǎnr hěn hǎo chī.
items.en: It's said that restaurant is delicious.

items.zh: 我听同学说明天不上课。
items.py: Wǒ tīng tóngxué shuō míngtiān bú shàng kè.
items.en: A classmate told me no class tomorrow.

items.zh: 听说明年他还要来中国。
items.py: Tīng shuō míngnián tā hái yào lái Zhōngguó.
items.en: I heard he'll come to China again next year.

items.zh: 听说她唱得不错。→听说他跳得很好。
items.py: Tīng shuō tā chàng de búcuò. → Tīng shuō tā tiào de hěn hǎo.
items.en: She sings well. → He dances well.

items.py: Tīng shuō míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
items.en: I heard there's an exam tomorrow.

items.py: Tīng shuō nàge dìfang hěn měi.
items.en: I heard that place is beautiful.

items.py: Jù shuō Zhōngguó de gāotiě hěn kuài.
items.en: It's said China's high-speed trains are very fast.

items.zh: 据说这本小说写得很好。
items.py: Jù shuō zhè běn xiǎoshuō xiě de hěn hǎo.
items.en: It's said this novel is well-written.
